newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-WORLD CUP WOMEN'S SUPER-G WINNER'S PROFILE.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WORLD CUP WOMEN'S SUPER-G WINNER'S PROFILE.

text.p: Profile of the winner of Friday's women's World Cup super-g race at Mammoth Mountain:
Career World Cup Wins: 27 (11 super-g, 12 Downhill, four giant slalom)
Other feats: Seizinger was the World Cup overall champion in 1996, a title she lost to Sweden's Pernilla Wiberg Friday.
She finished second overall in 1995 and 1993 and third overall in 1994.
Friday's super-g victory was her third win of the season, following gold medal runs in giant slalom at Soelden, Austria in October and downhill at Lake Louise, Canada in December.
